description: A bearded man in a linen shirt and dark leather apron holds a blowpipe with a glowing orange glass bulb at its tip, inspecting it. Behind him is a brick furnace with a fire-lit arch, a second worker in shadow, and a brick wall on the left with another fire. On a wooden table at right stand several clear stemmed wine glasses and a glass bottle. Clothing and tools look early modern or pre-industrial, and I see no text, numbers, frame or border.
